subject: expression: expression always read location from `types.Context` (#50636)
summary: Diff is limited to `pkg/expression/context.go`, switching `location(ctx)` from `SessionVars.Location()` to `StmtCtx.TypeCtx().Location()`. Checked the surrounding timezone plumbing: statement execution resets `StmtCtx` and sets its timezone from `SessionVars.Location()` (`executor.ResetContextOfStmt`), and `types.Context.Location()` is non-nil/UTC-safe, so the change aligns expression time/rounding semantics with the statement’s type context without introducing a correctness/compatibility regression in normal SQL execution.
